purpose: Prepare two separately learned legs of the existing left-to-right table-supported bottle relay, with physical replay before training.
data_gate: Both teacher legs and exact saved float32 endpoint replays must pass before collecting a larger training batch.
evaluation: Seed 42 is exposed. No holdout evaluation or learned success is implied.
additional_training_source: The passing exposed feasibility case is also training; combine compact inputs without overwriting either collection.
split_policy: No teacher collection from development or evaluation seeds. Freeze candidate before evaluation. Reverse test poses use the declared center with +/-6 mm XY and +/-0.08 rad yaw, sampled from each scene seed.

training_budget.promotion: Physical success on both legs without reset; report all declared evaluation cases and preserve every failed outcome.
